description: Slow, stable walks of a person, copied from the other libraries: 12 styles chosen from the 369 two-legged person styles of those libraries that walk at 0.9 leg lengths a second or less. Each of the 369 was walked for 6 s on soma's person (0.86 m legs) in the lab and measured, the best 121 were walked again for 8 s and measured with the worker's own frame clock, and a style is kept here when it walks at 0.60 m/s or under, takes real steps (0.28 m or more, 1.9 a second at most), is on both feet more than 55 % of the time and never in the air, does not lurch (the head's acceleration, sway and bob stay small), keeps the trunk upright and quiet, steps alike with both legs, does not sink a sole into the floor or let a planted foot skate, holds no prop and keeps the hands hanging by the hips. A style here is the library style of the same name without the 'slow_' in front, copied as it is (the numbers, the feet, the upper body). A creature takes one with legs: { gait: { from: name } }.
